scientific_integrity: An exact derivation is given; 576 finite checks are corroborative and not substituted for proof. Generic weighted Voronoi disconnectivity and Apollonian bisectors are credited to prior work.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the exact planar regular-ring configuration only; full motivating 2026 paper and older generalized tessellations were not inspected. Independent audit not performed.
title: Sharp connectivity and a three-halves area cusp in regular-ring weighted Voronoi cells
